body:
Implement slice 1 of the approved context-rot handoff design (docs/specs/context-rot-handoff.md — Cursor adversarial-review verdict approve). Productize F3 proactive handoff: absolute bands, session-terminal deny (D1–D3), signed resume-auth — as pure package + contract tests. No harness adapters (slices 4–6) and no build-gate migration (slice 3) in this ticket.

Binding design: docs/specs/context-rot-handoff.md and .adlc/specs/context-rot-handoff.md (keep in sync).

=== DELIVERABLES ===
1. Package `@adlc/context-handoff` with lib/thresholds.mjs (warn < handoff < hard; PCT/DEPTH/BYTES; shared imports only).
2. Pure helpers for multi-signal OR-join bands, headroom nags-only, mutation gate D1–D3, per-record authorized (hash match; null-ticket/null-hash never via resume-auth), deny lifecycle open|consumed, ensure_deny_marker fail-closed semantics (testable without full harness I/O where possible; use injectable fs for marker tests).
3. Contract tests covering the slice-1 matrix in the spec (thresholds, bands, mutation-gate, deny-lifecycle, deny-marker).
4. Workspace wiring so `node --test packages/context-handoff/test/*.test.mjs` runs in CI via existing package test discovery patterns.

=== ACCEPTANCE ===
- Binding specs present at both paths. Verification: `test -f docs/specs/context-rot-handoff.md && test -f .adlc/specs/context-rot-handoff.md`
- Thresholds invariant. Verification: `node --test packages/context-handoff/test/thresholds.test.mjs`
- Mutation gate D1–D3 + authorized. Verification: `node --test packages/context-handoff/test/mutation-gate.test.mjs`
- Absolute OR-join; no floor-delta band compare; headroom never suppresses deny. Verification: `node --test packages/context-handoff/test/bands.test.mjs`
- Denier sticky / consume / consumed D3. Verification: `node --test packages/context-handoff/test/deny-lifecycle.test.mjs`
- ensure_deny_marker fail-closed. Verification: `node --test packages/context-handoff/test/deny-marker.test.mjs`
- Spec-lint clean. Verification: `adlc spec-lint docs/specs/context-rot-handoff.md`

allow-suppression: none

Out of scope: CLI write/resume/bypass binaries beyond what's needed to unit-test pure libs; Pi/CC/Cursor adapters; build-gate consume migration; Proven CI bundle.
title: context-handoff slice 1: freeze deny-gate spec + contract tests
